reason: No proposal covers SDK type tests; sdk-types.ts has 191 @ts-expect-error lines, is in the tsconfig include and outside the vitest include globs.
No proposal concerns schemas; all six schemas have both a .valid.json and an .invalid.json fixture.
D-d07023 (no bare Error in packages/mobile) is a different requirement from documenting codes; all 36 AgentErrorCode/ENGINE_ERROR_CODES members appear in the reference pages.
No proposal covers core import layering; the only @e2e-dev imports in src are string text in init/engines.ts, other hits are comments or messages.
No proposal covers init presets; engines.ts imports only node:os and ./versions.ts and names engines inside strings.
No proposal covers @ai-sdk import placement; value imports of @ai-sdk/* are only in oauth constructor modules, copilot loads @ai-sdk/openai via await import, CLI names them only as text.
No proposal covers oauth exports; package exports list only the four oauth constructor subpaths and no entry re-exports oauth internals.
No proposal covers vitest config; projects include only tests/unit and tests/integration, so tests/live is excluded.
No proposal covers web engine imports; 33 imports from e2e/engine, but index.ts, browser.ts and evaluation.ts import (mostly types) from the main 'e2e' entry.
No proposal covers package manifests; web declares e2e as a peer and e2e lists @e2e-dev/web only in devDependencies.
D-d07023 is about thrown errors in packages/mobile, not imports; engine files import e2e/engine (16), with index.ts importing test from 'e2e' and tools.ts from e2e/agent; e2e is a peer.
No proposal covers AI SDK imports; only tools.ts (the ./tools subpath) imports from 'ai', and nothing in src imports tools.ts.
No proposal covers engine typing; ResolvedTarget.engine is EngineClientHandle | undefined and the client uses loopbackTransport for in-process engines.
No proposal covers integration packaging; each integration is @e2e-dev/<service> with the engine (and the vendor SDK where one exists) as peers.
No proposal covers integration imports; engine imports are type-only except testmu and browserstack, which value-import agentDeviceLeases from @e2e-dev/mobile/lease.
No proposal covers engine/integration layering; grep finds no import of an integration package in web or mobile src.
No proposal covers testmu entries; index.ts reaches only provider.ts (mobile) and web.ts only browsers.ts (web).
No proposal covers the GitHub reporter; reporter.ts imports renderMarkdownReport from 'e2e' and calls it.
No proposal covers reporter construction; github() only returns an object whose onRunFinished passes process.env and readFile to reportRun.
No proposal covers testbed; its test files are named after runner features (route, download, frames, selectors), not hard UI scenarios.
No proposal covers this suite; it has one test per verb (check, long press/double click, right-click, upload, back, scroll_to).
D-6c629b/D-ebee38 are about the components scenarios render, not test style; tests/ has no agent.* calls and tests-agent runs one agent.act per scenario in a loop.
The rendering proposals for mobile-benchmark do not address naming; which companies scenarios came from, and diffs against the source, can't be determined from the checkout.
No proposal covers examples; no lockfiles are present, examples are outside the workspace globs and depend on published ^ ranges.
No proposal covers examples; all ten example folders appear in both examples.json and init/examples.ts.
No proposal covers example layout; swiftui, compose, kotlin-multiplatform, flutter and maui all have an e2e/ folder.
No proposal covers import extensions; among ~3760 relative imports, the only non-.ts specifiers are inside string fixtures.
No proposal covers optional props; 468 conditional spreads, plus about 23 explicit `: undefined` assignments in src (likely on required `| undefined` fields under exactOptionalPropertyTypes).
No proposal covers dead code; checking would require running fallow.
No proposal covers test-only exports; whole-workspace usage analysis would need the tooling.
No proposal covers JSDoc; about 987 of 1048 exported functions are preceded by a doc comment, with gaps mostly in src/oauth.
No proposal covers comments; the inline comments sampled explain why.
No proposal covers vitest config; the integration project has pool 'forks' and maxWorkers: 3.
No proposal covers integration tests; most use the tmp-projects helpers and computed dist specifiers, but about 13 files use os.tmpdir/mkdtemp.
No proposal covers agentic assertions; model-extracted text is checked with toContain, and exact matches are on deterministic values or error codes.
No proposal covers agentic tests; every agent.act is followed by expect(screen.getBy...), but agent.assert judgment steps are not.
No proposal covers crosscheck; every line carries a reason and there are no TODO reasons.
No proposal covers crosscheck; the vocabulary policies (ENGINE_NAMED_ROLES, ENGINE_ONLY_ROLES, CHROME_ROLES...) sit at the top of crosscheck.ts with reasons.
No proposal covers this; it depends on change history, which the checkout doesn't show.
No proposal covers fixtures; pages are static HTML except one ('list rebuilt every millisecond') that builds synchronously and then rebuilds with setInterval.
No proposal covers conformance; the file has no Bug: lines and is sorted by case, so grouping by reason and deletion on fix can't be judged.
No proposal covers fail-closed security; the samples throw POLICY_DENIED, but a full assessment is not possible statically.
No proposal covers secret redaction; redaction exists, but coverage of every sink can't be verified by reading.
No proposal covers reporting; memory is never referenced from src/report.
No proposal covers secret fills; typeSecret requires a declared step secret, resolves via commitTargeted/feed and calls authorizeSecretFill.
No proposal covers tool-call parsing; strict schema use and per-call authorization can't be confirmed from the samples.
D-d07023 (bare Error) is a different rule; LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND is used for missing nodes, but POLICY_DENIED also covers unrequested tools and secure-field reads.
No proposal covers this; new Function is used for user evaluate code and selector engines, and whether model text can reach it can't be traced statically.
No proposal covers navigation; app.open, the navigate verb and browser.goto (via context.app.resolveUrl) all go through resolveNavigationUrl.
D-d07023 is about bare errors, not link schemes; links.ts has FORBIDDEN_PROTOCOLS with all six schemes.
No proposal covers sessions; sessions use aes-256-gcm with an in-memory key and target-keyed paths, but the no-logging part was not fully verified.
No proposal covers reporter escaping; escaping helpers exist, but full coverage can't be determined.
No proposal covers retired names; they appear only in changelogs and docs prose, never in code or manifests.
No proposal covers lint categories; compliance would require running oxlint.

No proposal covers lint categories; compliance would require running oxlint.
No proposal covers type assertions; only two `as unknown as` chains in src, each under an oxlint-disable with a reason.
No proposal covers JSON parsing; most JSON.parse results go to schemas or unknown vars, with a few exceptions such as an `as Readonly<Record<...>>` in act-validation.ts.
No proposal covers class members; checking would require running fallow.
No proposal covers dependency classification; checking would require running fallow.
No proposal covers deprecations; the one deprecated API found (easSimulators/EasSimulatorsOptions) is a plain alias with no runtime warning.
No proposal covers agent.act style; a scan of all 69 agent.act calls found each followed by an expect.
No proposal covers test delays; 16 of 137 e2e files contain setTimeout delays, some inside page-evaluated code.
No proposal covers credentials; valid credentials come from credentials.user(), and literals are only deliberately invalid values.
No proposal covers agentContext; no e2e test file uses agentContext.
No proposal covers test imports; imports come from 'e2e'/@e2e-dev/web/@e2e-dev/mobile, except 9 mobile-benchmark files that import from a local fixtures.ts.
No proposal covers config shape; most of 26 configs follow it, but a few variant configs differ in import form or spread a base config without naming engine: web()/mobile().
No proposal covers waits; setTimeout appears in 16 of 137 e2e files, and none in examples.
No proposal covers secrets; sensitive values come from credentials.user() and are passed to fill() or act params.
The mobile-benchmark rendering proposals don't address test placement; testbed holds feature tests and the benchmarks hold scenario suites.
No proposal covers comment style; sampled comments explain why rather than narrate.
No proposal covers defensive checks; whether a check is needed can't be judged statically.
No proposal covers casts; no `any` types found in src, but there are about 111 `as T` casts, some of which silence types.
No proposal covers dead code; detecting it requires the fallow tool or change history.
No proposal covers retries; about 12 hand-rolled sleep/poll sites appear in packages src.
No proposal covers in-page code; JSON.stringify is not used, but read-semantics.ts uses instanceof 26 times, and whether any check crosses frames is unclear.
No proposal covers naming; about 18 identifiers with browser/route/page nouns, mostly in oauth (sign-in browser) and cache routing rather than engine concepts.
No proposal covers platform paths; this can't be assessed statically.
